milestone.title: Plan annotation system (review requests + approval gate)

intent.outcome: A new annotation artifact (AN-##) that lets humans (via raul) mark milestones/steps/docs for AI review, request break-downs/decouples/changes, suggest edits, or request approval — stored in annotations.toml alongside canonical docs without modifying them — with agents reading the open queue via mp annotation and transitioning items open -> addressed -> resolved. An open approval-request annotation HARD-BLOCKS the target milestones spec_status: ready (gate G14), making approve-before-ready a real enforcement rather than advisory.

problem.description: Humans reviewing the plan (via raul) have no way to leave actionable feedback on plan entities without editing canonical docs. They want to mark a milestone for AI review, request a break-down or decouple, suggest a change, or request approval — and track whether the agent addressed it. Agents need a queue to pick up these requests. This must not mutate canonical docs (specs stay clean); annotations live alongside, as ideas/backlog already do. Approval requests should be enforceable, not just advisory, so a spec cannot silently go ready over an unaddressed approval demand.

in_scope: New plan artifact: annotation items (AN-##) in master-plan/annotations.toml (single queue file, mirroring ideas.toml/backlog.toml precedent)
Annotation types in crates/mp-model: AnnotationFile + AnnotationItem (serde), mirroring IdeaEntry/BacklogItem; re-exported from mp

Annotation item shape: id, target (M## / M##/S## / doc path), kind (review-request | break-down | decouple | change-suggestion | approval-request | note), body, author, status (open | addressed | resolved), created_at, resolved_at
mp annotation commands mirroring mp idea: create, list (--open / --target / --kind / --author filters), show, update, resolve, reopen, remove

3-state lifecycle: human creates (open) -> agent does work and marks addressed -> human verifies and marks resolved. approval-request typically open -> resolved directly (human action). Invalid transitions rejected.

Gate G14: a milestone with an open (non-resolved) approval-request annotation cannot reach spec_status: ready; integrated into validate_milestone_ready + mp validate. Resolving the annotation unblocks it.
Schema + validation gate R1 (missing/invalid target, body, kind, status) for annotations.toml; mp validate covers it
mp sync indexes annotation counts into plan state
Open annotation count surfaced in mp status + mp inbox (mirroring the idea/backlog inbox loop at inbox.rs:98-114)
raul annotation surface: create delegates to mp annotation create (raul never writes annotations.toml); list/show read via mp --format json; gate test asserts no annotations.toml write path in raul
Docs: MP-COMMANDS.md (annotation commands + G14), AGENT-PLAYBOOK.md (agent annotation loop), SPEC.md (G14 gate matrix row), master-planner SKILL.md (annotation workflow)
Golden scenario + integration tests for the annotation lifecycle (create -> list -> addressed -> resolved) and the G14 gate (open approval blocks ready; resolved unblocks)
out_of_scope: raul TUI (that is M44) — this milestone ships data model + mp commands + raul CLI surface only
Editing/rewriting canonical plan docs from an annotation (annotations are requests; agents apply changes via existing mp commands)
Per-entity sidecar files (single queue file chosen)
Auto-promoting annotations into tracks/milestones (the agent resolves by doing the work via existing mp commands)
Annotation threading/nested comments (one item, one resolution; no discussion tree)
Gate-blocking for non-approval kinds (only approval-request hard-blocks ready; other kinds are advisory tracking)

work_packages.name: Data model + storage

work_packages.name: mp commands + validation + gate
work_packages.goal: mp annotation command surface; R1 validation gate; G14 approval gate; status/inbox surfacing

steps.action: Add AnnotationFile + AnnotationItem types to crates/mp-model/src/lib.rs (serde Serialize/Deserialize), mirroring IdeaEntry/BacklogItem. Fields: id, target (String), kind (String), body (String), author (String), status (String), created_at, resolved_at. kind allowed values: review-request | break-down | decouple | change-suggestion | approval-request | note. status allowed values: open | addressed | resolved. Re-export from mp so internal modules see them.
steps.tests: cargo build --release -p mp-model && cargo build --release -p mp
steps.done_when: AnnotationFile/AnnotationItem compile in mp-model with serde; mp re-exports them; cargo build green

steps.action: Storage layer: add load_annotations plus a write helper to store.rs, following the SAME pattern idea.rs uses to persist ideas (idea.rs has no save_ideas function; it writes via the store resource writer - mirror that exact code path). Storage file is master-plan/annotations.toml as a [[annotations]] array. Add an annotations bootstrap seed to store::init_plan (store.rs:29; note there is no store::init) that creates an empty annotations.toml on mp init if absent. mp sync (sync.rs) rebuilds/updates annotation counts in plan state. Round-trip save/load preserves items.
steps.done_when: load_annotations and the idea.rs-mirrored write helper work; mp init (init_plan) creates an empty annotations.toml; mp sync indexes annotation counts; round-trip save/load preserves items

steps.action: Implement mp annotation create / list / show. create takes target, kind, body, author and appends an AN-## item (status open, created_at stamped). list supports --open, --target, --kind, --author filters. show <id> prints one item. All emit stable --format json (the agent API per ADR-008/D-011). Add CLI variant + app dispatch + commands/annotation.rs handler mirroring commands/idea.rs.
steps.done_when: mp annotation create/list/show work and emit stable --format json; filters function; AN-## ids auto-assigned

steps.action: Implement mp annotation update / resolve / reopen / remove with 3-state transition enforcement. Valid transitions: open->addressed, open->resolved, addressed->resolved, resolved->open (reopen). Reject invalid transitions (e.g. resolved->addressed) with a clear error. update edits body/kind/author. resolve stamps resolved_at. remove deletes the item.
steps.done_when: update/resolve/reopen/remove work; invalid transitions rejected with errors; resolved_at stamped on resolve; stable --format json

steps.action: Add schema + R1 validation gate for annotations.toml. Schema (mini_schema) rejects items missing/invalid target, body, kind (not in allowed set), or status (not in allowed set). Add a validate_annotations function in validate.rs emitting R1 issues; wire it into mp validate so malformed annotations fail validation.
steps.done_when: Schema validates annotation items; mp validate emits R1 for missing/invalid target/body/kind/status; valid annotations pass

steps.action: Implement gate G14: a milestone with a non-resolved (open or addressed) approval-request annotation cannot reach spec_status: ready. NOTE: validate_milestone_ready (validate.rs:342) takes only (m: &MilestoneFile) and has no access to annotations, so G14 is implemented where ctx IS available: (a) in validate_plan (validate.rs:22, ctx in scope) by loading annotations once and scanning for kind=approval-request targeting the milestone (M## or its steps) with status != resolved; (b) at the mp milestone set-spec-status <id> ready AND mp milestone approve call sites (inject an annotation check there). Resolving the annotation clears the block. Only approval-request blocks; other kinds do not.
steps.done_when: G14 blocks ready when an open approval-request annotation targets the milestone, firing on mp milestone set-spec-status ready, mp milestone approve, AND mp validate; resolving the annotation unblocks; only approval-request blocks (other kinds do not)

steps.action: Surface open annotation counts and a per-milestone gate flag in mp status and mp inbox, mirroring the idea/backlog loop at inbox.rs:98-114. mp status --format json includes an annotations open count (computed on-demand; do NOT add a field to PlanFile/mp-model - compute from annotations.toml at status time) AND a per-milestone approval_blocked boolean (or gates_blocked list) so raul (M44) can render the blocked indicator without re-deriving gate logic. mp inbox lists open annotations as actionable items with an mp annotation show <id> action hint.
steps.done_when: mp status --format json includes open annotation count (on-demand, no PlanFile change) and a per-milestone approval_blocked flag; mp inbox lists open annotations; raul status picks it up via the same JSON

steps.action: Implement raul annotation: raul annotation create prompts for target/kind/body and delegates to mp annotation create (shell-out, never writes annotations.toml). raul annotation list/show read via mp --format json and render styled views. Add a gate test asserting raul source has no annotations.toml write path (no save_annotations, no fs::write to annotations.toml) — only the mp annotation create delegation.
steps.done_when: raul annotation create/list/show work via mp delegation; gate test confirms raul never writes annotations.toml; styled rendering

steps.action: Docs: MP-COMMANDS.md (mp annotation command reference + examples + G14 note), AGENT-PLAYBOOK.md (agent annotation loop: read open queue -> do work -> mark addressed/resolve), SPEC.md (add G14 row to the gate matrix + R1 annotation note), master-planner SKILL.md (annotation workflow for humans/agents). Also refresh the master-planner SKILL.md error-code table (its gate section currently lists only G1-G10) to include G11-G14.
steps.tests: manual: accepted — doc review (commands, agent loop, G14 gate matrix, SKILL workflow)
steps.done_when: All four docs document the annotation workflow + G14 end-to-end; SKILL.md gate table covers G1-G14; no stale references

steps.action: Golden scenario + integration tests for the full annotation lifecycle and the G14 gate. Add a golden scenario under tests/scenarios/ exercising create -> list -> addressed -> resolved, and an approval-request blocking then unblocking a milestone ready transition. Confirm mp validate and set-spec-status ready both honor G14. Full green pass.
steps.tests: make test-scenarios && cargo test -p mp annotation
steps.done_when: Golden scenario passes; integration tests cover lifecycle + G14 block/unblock; make test + make test-scenarios green
